description: Talk to the ManyLives Brain in plain words: say what you need (no task type or fields needed). The Brain asks only what it must, then screens and lists the job, gathers quotes, recommends one and assigns it when you agree. Pass conversation_id (and the token you got, if you're not a member) to continue.

conversation_id.description: Continue an earlier conversation (from the previous reply).

message.description: What you need or want to ask, in plain words.

token.description: The conversation token from the first reply (not needed for members).

name: talk
title: Talk
